headword: {公衆電話|こうしゅうでんわ}

definitions.explanation: A telephone available for public use, typically operated with coins or prepaid cards. Still found in Japan at stations and convenience stores.

examples.japanese: {公衆電話|こうしゅうでんわ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

examples.english: There is a payphone in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{公衆電話|こうしゅうでんわ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: My phone battery died, so I made a call from a payphone.

notes:
USAGE:
{公衆電話|こうしゅうでんわ} combines ⟦{公衆|こうしゅう}→公衆：11660_koushuu⟧ (public) and ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧ (telephone). Although their numbers have decreased with the spread of mobile phones, payphones remain in Japan for emergency use. Green payphones accept テレホン⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧ (telephone cards) and coins.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公衆電話|こうしゅうでんわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to make a call from a payphone)
- {公衆電話|こうしゅうでんわ}⟦ボックス→ボックス：30522_bokkusu⟧ (phone booth)
- {公衆電話|こうしゅうでんわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{設置場所|せっちばしょ} (payphone location)
